paragraphs: The X5 xDrive50i was the flagship petrol V8 in the F15 generation, produced from 2013 to 2018. It uses the N63 — BMW's 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, part of the hot-vee engine family that places the turbochargers inside the vee of the engine for a compact layout. While the X5 range continued into the G05 generation (2018–present) with the M60i V8, the xDrive50i badge was retired with the F15 — the G05's equivalent V8 carries a different badge, engine code and spec.
about.boldParagraph: The X5 xDrive50i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
